svg.title: TextFlowKit v0.1.11 optional local live streaming
svg.desc: Windows x86_64 only, off by default. A browser AudioWorklet or programmatic PCM client feeds signed 16-bit little-endian mono 16000 Hz audio into an authenticated loopback WebSocket: /stream on the developer HTTP API or /api/stream on the UI. Origin, Host and peer checks guard the transport. StreamingSession bounds audio backlog at five seconds and defaults to one native session per process. One owned child binds directly to a separately pinned libneedle3.dll. Incremental committed text and a replacement provisional tail return to the client. Finish flushes accepted audio and returns a canonical Transcript; cancel or disconnect cleans up the owned child. No durable job, replay or resume. Existing standalone Whistle defaults remain unchanged. The public site serves no streams; physical microphone capture was not verified.
svg.text: Windows x86_64 only · streaming extra + TEXTFLOWKIT_STREAMING=1 · off by default
Incremental events: append committed text + replace the provisional tail
Finish: flush accepted PCM → canonical Transcript. Cancel / disconnect: release the owned session.
Ephemeral stream: no durable job row, replay or resume. Existing standalone Whistle defaults stay unchanged.
Evidence: 65 s / 300 s native core PCM runs; separate 12 s UI WebSocket PCM run. Physical mic not verified.
This is a local app capability. The public website is static documentation and serves no streams.
